title: OPS — /golive /audit /pace /calendar: exclude dry-run posts
summary: Fixed cmdGoLive(), cmdAudit(), cmdPace() queue section, and cmdCalendar() to use readRealPosts() instead of raw manual-posts.jsonl reads. Dry-run posts no longer inflate post counts or incorrectly mark videos as posted in these commands.
root_cause: cmdGoLive, cmdAudit, cmdPace queue section, and cmdCalendar all built postedIds or postsCount from raw manual-posts.jsonl, including dry-run entries.
fix: Use readRealPosts() (already imported) in each function. Removed unused mpPath and manualPath/manualPath2 variables.
